pages.title: Rite of Repose
pages.text: The $(l)Wakeful Doom$() curse stops Branded players from sleeping. Near a $(l)Rite of Repose$(), you can sleep again.

pages.title: Somnolent Dust
pages.text: Made from Phantom Membrane, Amethyst, and Glowstone.

pages.title: Resting
pages.text: While Branded, you can sleep in any bed within $(thing)8 blocks$() of the altar. Normal sleep rules still apply.$(br2)The altar glows blue when a Branded player is in range. Use the altar to show its radius.$(br2)It only stops Wakeful Doom. It doesn't affect your other curses or the Relic. To remove the Oath, see the $(l)Rite of Severance$().
